name: a-grounded-answer-cites-its-sources
description: SPEC.md 4.2 (v1.18): with citation on, a run that answered ends with one line per source of the knowledge recalled into it, after a blank line. The source of a passage from the built-in knowledge folder is the document's path relative to the folder. The model never wrote the line: the implementation did, so an implementation that only asks the model to cite fails here, because this scripted Brain never will.
prompt: what is our refund policy for enterprise customers

knowledge.refunds.md: Refund policy. Enterprise customers may request a refund within 90 days of purchase.
knowledge.shipping.md: Shipping policy. Orders ship within two business days.
knowledge.holidays.md: The office is closed on public holidays.

expect.result:
enterprise customers have 90 days

Source: refunds.md
